en: Black‑and‑white view across a calm pond or small lake in a park-like setting. Tall deciduous trees frame the water and are reflected in its surface. In the foreground on the right stands a small wooden or stone structure on a post by the water's edge. Across the pond are low footbridges and a few figures near the shore. In the distant background, partly obscured by trees, rises a church with a tall tower and baroque-style dome or spire. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.
